new_issues.title: The mount catch logs every mount-stage failure (resize, observer setup, subscriptions) as 'provider create failed'.
new_issues.why: The try at lines 240-301 covers create, initial resize, ResizeObserver setup and both subscriptions, and the catch logs a fixed 'provider create failed' message. The underlying Error with its own message and stack is still logged and committed as error state, so only the log label is misleading.

new_issues.title: Exported React components lack the explicit return types the TypeScript rules require.
new_issues.why: The new ChartRoute has no return annotation, against .claude/rules/typescript.md:130; App and RootLayout signatures are unchanged from base. Style convention only, no behavior impact.
